critiques.subject: Formal dining room featuring black paneled walls, a long mahogany table, and a modern gold chandelier
improvements: [SIGNIFICANT] Apply vertical perspective correction (Transform/Upright)
[MODERATE] Reduce highlights in background windows and reflections
[SUBTLE] Local adjustment to center table (Warmth + Clarity)
[SUBTLE] Lift shadows in black paneling
preserve: The deep, rich saturation of the black walls
The metallic gold tones of the chandelier
critiques.notes: A well-composed interior shot with great depth, but heavily impacted by lens distortion. Straightening the vertical lines is the critical step to transforming this from a casual wide-angle shot into a polished real estate or architectural image.

improvements_detailed.action: Apply vertical perspective correction (Transform/Upright)
improvements_detailed.reason: The wide-angle lens has caused significant keystoning; vertical lines (walls, curtains) are leaning outward and need to be straightened for professional architectural standards.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights in background windows and reflections
improvements_detailed.reason: The bright light sources in the adjacent room and mirror are blown out; reducing highlights will help recover detail and balance the dynamic range.

improvements_detailed.action: Local adjustment to center table (Warmth + Clarity)
improvements_detailed.reason: Enhancing the wood tones will create better separation from the dark walls and anchor the composition.

improvements_detailed.action: Lift shadows in black paneling
improvements_detailed.reason: Slightly lifting the darkest shadows will reveal the texture of the paneling joinery without turning the black paint grey.

critiques.subject: A moody dining room interior with a long wooden table, dark paneled walls, chandelier, and fireplace
improvements: [MODERATE] Enable lens profile corrections and apply Transform (guided/upright) to straighten verticals and reduce wide-angle distortion; fine-tune with a slight rotate if needed
[MODERATE] Recover highlights on the ceiling/chandelier area (Highlights -30 to -60) and add a gentle top gradient to reduce brightness; optionally lower Whites slightly (-10 to -20)
[SUBTLE] Open shadows selectively on the dark wall paneling and corners (Shadows +15 to +30) while holding blacks with a mild Blacks -5 to -15; use local masks to avoid flattening the scene
[SUBTLE] Refine white balance slightly cooler overall (Temp -200 to -500K) and reduce orange saturation in wood tones via HSL (Orange Sat -5 to -15, Orange Lum +5 to +10)
[SUBTLE] Add localized clarity/texture to the table centerpiece and fireplace wall (+10 to +20) and apply mild sharpening with masking (Amount ~40–60, Masking ~70+)
preserve: The strong leading lines created by the long table and chairs
The dark, high-contrast paneling that gives the room its dramatic character
critiques.notes: This is a strong interior composition with great symmetry and a clear focal path down the table toward the fireplace. The main gains will come from perspective correction and better highlight control near the ceiling/chandelier, plus subtle shadow recovery to reveal panel detail without losing the moody look.

improvements_detailed.action: Enable lens profile corrections and apply Transform (guided/upright) to straighten verticals and reduce wide-angle distortion; fine-tune with a slight rotate if needed
improvements_detailed.reason: The room lines (paneling, doorway, mirror) feel a bit stretched/tilted, and correcting perspective will make the interior look more natural and professional.

improvements_detailed.action: Recover highlights on the ceiling/chandelier area (Highlights -30 to -60) and add a gentle top gradient to reduce brightness; optionally lower Whites slightly (-10 to -20)
improvements_detailed.reason: The ceiling and chandelier draw attention away from the table; pulling them back improves balance while keeping the room’s drama.

improvements_detailed.action: Open shadows selectively on the dark wall paneling and corners (Shadows +15 to +30) while holding blacks with a mild Blacks -5 to -15; use local masks to avoid flattening the scene
improvements_detailed.reason: Reveals detail/texture in the dark walls without losing the intended moody contrast.

improvements_detailed.action: Refine white balance slightly cooler overall (Temp -200 to -500K) and reduce orange saturation in wood tones via HSL (Orange Sat -5 to -15, Orange Lum +5 to +10)
improvements_detailed.reason: Keeps the wood rich but prevents the image from feeling overly warm compared to the darker, cooler walls.

improvements_detailed.action: Add localized clarity/texture to the table centerpiece and fireplace wall (+10 to +20) and apply mild sharpening with masking (Amount ~40–60, Masking ~70+)
improvements_detailed.reason: Improves perceived crispness where the eye should land, while avoiding sharpening noise in flatter areas.

critiques.subject: A formal dining room with a long wooden table, dark paneled walls, and a large chandelier
critiques.mood: Elegant, moody, upscale interior with warm accents
improvements: [MODERATE] Apply lens corrections and vertical/horizontal perspective transform to straighten converging lines (walls, window frames) and level the room
[MODERATE] Lift midtones/shadows selectively on the dark wall paneling (+15 to +30 shadows) while keeping blacks anchored (slight black point) to maintain the moody look
[SUBTLE] Reduce highlights/whites on the chandelier and ceiling (Highlights -20 to -40, Whites -5 to -15) and add a subtle local burn to the ceiling hotspot

[SUBTLE] Neutralize mixed lighting with a small WB tweak cooler (Temp slightly down) and use local color correction: reduce yellow/orange saturation on the chandelier/ceiling and slightly raise blue/cyan in shadows
[SUBTLE] Tighten composition with a slight crop from the left edge (reduce dominance of the large framed artwork) and/or bottom edge to emphasize the table-to-fireplace axis
preserve: The strong central leading line created by the long table toward the fireplace
The rich contrast between the warm wood table and the dark paneled walls
critiques.notes: The image is sharp with a pleasing, upscale mood and strong leading lines. Minor perspective correction and targeted tonal balancing (lifting dark panel detail while taming ceiling/chandelier highlights) would make it feel more polished and true to an interior/architectural standard.

improvements_detailed.action: Apply lens corrections and vertical/horizontal perspective transform to straighten converging lines (walls, window frames) and level the room
improvements_detailed.reason: Architectural/interior images read as higher quality when geometry is clean and level; it reduces the wide-angle distortion feel.

improvements_detailed.action: Lift midtones/shadows selectively on the dark wall paneling (+15 to +30 shadows) while keeping blacks anchored (slight black point) to maintain the moody look
improvements_detailed.reason: Recovers texture and detail in the paneling and corners without flattening the intended dark, elegant atmosphere.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights/whites on the chandelier and ceiling (Highlights -20 to -40, Whites -5 to -15) and add a subtle local burn to the ceiling hotspot
improvements_detailed.reason: Controls the brightest area so it doesn’t dominate attention and improves perceived dynamic range.

improvements_detailed.action: Neutralize mixed lighting with a small WB tweak cooler (Temp slightly down) and use local color correction: reduce yellow/orange saturation on the chandelier/ceiling and slightly raise blue/cyan in shadows
improvements_detailed.reason: Balances warm chandelier light against cooler window light, keeping the wood warm while preventing the ceiling from looking overly yellow.

improvements_detailed.action: Tighten composition with a slight crop from the left edge (reduce dominance of the large framed artwork) and/or bottom edge to emphasize the table-to-fireplace axis
improvements_detailed.reason: Strengthens the central symmetry and directs attention to the room’s primary features (table, chandelier, fireplace).
